title: Add or remove a specified tote using the Tote Management API (Add Tote / Remove Tote)
summary: Use the Totes Aveva API page ("API Features for Tote Management") to add a specified tote to the system or remove a specified tote from the system using the "Add Tote" and "Remove Tote" functions, then record the API response.
when_to_use: When you need to add a specific tote to the system or remove a specific tote from the system via the Tote Management API functions labeled "Add Tote" and "Remove Tote" on the Totes Aveva API page.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the Tote Management API add/remove action and capture the API response for escalation if needed.
access_or_tools_needed: Totes Aveva API page / "API Features for Tote Management"
Obeyba access (implied by the source login question)

access_required: Access to the Totes Aveva API page ("API Features for Tote Management")

visual_references.description: Totes Aveva API page showing "API Features for Tote Management" with functions including "Add Tote" and "Remove Tote".

steps.title: Navigate to the "API Features for Tote Management" page on the Totes Aveva API screen
steps.purpose: Open the Tote Management API functions so you can use "Add Tote" or "Remove Tote".
steps.instruction: Open the Totes Aveva API screen and navigate to the page/section labeled "API Features for Tote Management". Confirm you are logged in (the source indicates a login check for Obeyba).
steps.expected_result: The "API Features for Tote Management" page is visible and shows the function list including "Add Tote" and "Remove Tote".
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the "Add Tote" and "Remove Tote" functions on the "API Features for Tote Management" page.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the page or the "Add Tote"/"Remove Tote" functions are not visible (e.g., not logged in).

actions.label: Verify API page is loaded
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the “API Features for Tote Management” page on the Totes Aveva API screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "API Features for Tote Management" shows "Add Tote" and "Remove Tote"; OCR includes: “Adds a specified tote to the system” and “Removes a specified tote from the system.” Nearby transcript: “Are you logged in to Obeyba?”

steps.title: Locate the function labeled “Add Tote” and the function labeled “Remove Tote”
steps.purpose: Ensure you select the correct API function for the requested tote action.
steps.instruction: On the "API Features for Tote Management" page, find the function labeled "Add Tote" and the function labeled "Remove Tote".
steps.expected_result: Both "Add Tote" and "Remove Tote" are located on the page.
steps.healthy_condition: The function labels "Add Tote" and "Remove Tote" are visible in the API features list.
steps.failure_condition: Only one of the functions is visible, or neither function is visible.

actions.label: Identify correct API functions
actions.exact_action: Locate the function labeled “Add Tote” and the function labeled “Remove Tote”.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Context record summary: “Tote management API functions shown include Add Tote to add a specified tote to the system and Remove Tote to remove a specified tote from the system.” OCR on the page includes both function descriptions.

steps.title: Add a tote using “Add Tote”
steps.purpose: Add the specified tote to the system using the API function intended for adding totes.
steps.instruction: Select the "Add Tote" function and enter the specified tote identifier when prompted, then submit the request.
steps.expected_result: The API adds the specified tote to the system and returns a response indicating the action was issued.
steps.healthy_condition: After submitting "Add Tote", the API response is returned (non-empty) indicating the action was issued.
steps.failure_condition: The add action fails or returns an error/empty response.

actions.label: Submit Add Tote request
actions.exact_action: To add a tote: use “Add Tote” and enter the specified tote identifier when prompted.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the add/remove action fails or returns an error/empty response, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Add Tote" adds a specified tote to the system.

steps.title: Remove a tote using “Remove Tote”
steps.purpose: Remove the specified tote from the system using the API function intended for removing totes.
steps.instruction: Select the "Remove Tote" function and enter the specified tote identifier when prompted, then submit the request.
steps.expected_result: The API removes the specified tote from the system and returns a response indicating the action was issued.
steps.healthy_condition: After submitting "Remove Tote", the API response is returned (non-empty) indicating the action was issued.
steps.failure_condition: The remove action fails or returns an error/empty response.

actions.label: Submit Remove Tote request
actions.exact_action: To remove a tote: use “Remove Tote” and enter the specified tote identifier when prompted.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the add/remove action fails or returns an error/empty response, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Remove Tote" removes a specified tote from the system.

steps.title: Record the API response after the add/remove action
steps.purpose: Capture the outcome returned by the Tote Management API for confirmation and escalation.
steps.instruction: After you submit either "Add Tote" or "Remove Tote", record the API response shown by the interface.
steps.expected_result: An API response is recorded for the performed action (add or remove).
steps.healthy_condition: You have captured the response content shown after the request submission.
steps.failure_condition: No response is shown, or the response is blank/empty.

actions.label: Capture response
actions.exact_action: Record the API response shown after the add/remove action.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the add/remove action fails or returns an error/empty response, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate expected behavior: API returns a response indicating the action was issued; candidate notes: record the API response after the add/remove action.

success_criteria: For "Add Tote": the API returns a response indicating the add action was issued for the specified tote.
For "Remove Tote": the API returns a response indicating the remove action was issued for the specified tote.
The API response is recorded after the action.
healthy_conditions: The "API Features for Tote Management" page shows both "Add Tote" and "Remove Tote" functions.
After submitting the request, the API response is returned and is not empty.
failure_conditions: The add/remove action fails or returns an error/empty response.
The API response is blank/empty after submission.
escalation_guidance: If the add/remove action fails or returns an error/empty response, stop and escalate (no further troubleshooting steps are provided by the source).
